neighbours.label: Modal or causal phrasing introducing a possible problem or adverse consequence.
fire: During the final review, unsupported claims may be rejected by the editorial board.

According to the ambassador, a prolonged military presence may cause political tension.
During restoration, workers must lift the fragile panel without causing further damage.
By the third mile, the tight boots were causing severe pain around her ankles.
On an icy road, even a gentle turn can be dangerous.
